## In class

Students exchange dataset descriptions and give peer feedback. We finish by creating a shared **Critical Data Practice Checklist**.

## Output

The shared Critical Data Practice Checklist.

::: {.callout-tip title="The final test for a dataset"}
Do we know what it contains, how it was made, what it leaves out, and what we can responsibly do with it?
:::

## After Day 2

Write a concise description of the dataset you brought to class. The [assignments](../assignments.qmd) page lists the eight questions that your text must answer.
